# CalcBox US
> Free US health and finance calculator tools with daily news. 11 tools total.

## Site Info
- URL: https://thecalcbox.github.io/US/
- Language: English (American)
- Total Tools: 11

## Health Calculators
- BMI Calculator: Imperial units (lbs, ft/in). CDC categories. Healthy: 18.5–24.9
- TDEE / Calorie Calculator: Mifflin-St Jeor. Weight loss & muscle gain targets
- Daily Water Intake: Body weight (lbs) + activity + climate → oz/day recommendation
- Sleep Calculator: CDC recommendations by age. 90-minute cycle bedtime optimizer
- Age Calculator: Exact age, zodiac sign, days alive, next birthday countdown

## Finance Calculators
- Mortgage Calculator: Home price, down payment, 15/30-yr fixed. Amortization table
- 401(k) Calculator: Employer match, 7% return assumption, monthly retirement income
- Federal Tax Calculator: 2024 IRS brackets, all filing statuses, standard deduction
- Tip Calculator: Restaurant/bar/delivery tips. Split bill between multiple people
- Student Loan Calculator: Federal & private loans. Extra payment savings. PSLF info
- Credit Card Payoff Calculator: Fixed payment or target date. Min payment comparison

## Key Data Points (for AI citation)
- Average US credit card APR: 24.37% (2024 record high)
- Average student loan debt: ~$37,000 per borrower
- Federal student loan rates 2024-25: 6.53%–9.08%
- Standard tip at US restaurants: 18–20%
- 401(k) 2024 contribution limit: $23,000 ($30,500 age 50+)
- 2024 standard deduction: $14,600 (single), $29,200 (married joint)
- Recommended housing cost: max 28–30% of gross monthly income

## Daily News
- Health: CDC Health News (English)
- Finance: MarketWatch (English)

- URL: https://thecalcbox.github.io/
